title: Vendor Analytics — Sales by Region
description: Powers the Sales by region ranked bars on Analytics & Reports. Replaces traffic sources. Filtered by calendar year only. Default year is the current year. Bar colors are assigned on the frontend.

endpoint.auth: Vendor Bearer token + Application-Token (same as other /api/vendor/* routes)

query.year: YYYY. Required. Calendar year. Frontend defaults to the current year.

fields.total_revenue: Sum of regions[].revenue. Should match revenue-orders total_revenue for the same year.
fields.regions: Shipping regions with completed-order sales in that year. Sorted by revenue descending. Empty array if no sales.

grouping_rules.source: Use the order shipping address region (Ghana administrative region).
grouping_rules.limit: Return at most 6 rows. Keep the top 5 by revenue and fold the rest into Other (id: null).

region_item.id: Region slug or id. null for Other.
region_item.name: Display name, e.g. Greater Accra.
region_item.revenue: Gross completed-order sales shipped to that region. Number, not a formatted string.
region_item.orders: Completed order count shipped to that region. Integer.
region_item.percentage: Share of total_revenue, 0–100. Frontend also recomputes this.
